regions.cleaned_text: I hope this finds you improving on the report received recently from Mildred in Chicago. I offered my holy Mass for you today and have been including you and yours in all my prayers and holy Masses. I am really ashamed of myself that I write so very seldom. Still, when I am confident that my dear ones are in the grace of God -- keeping up the "good fight" and at the same time when I know so many languishing under their icad of temptations -- so often with little or no faith I just feel I must do something to encourage and, like- rescue them. There are so many whose faith seems to be chilled and benumbed by materialism and forgetfullness of our primary purpose as rational creatures, viz; grate- fully to recognize our greatest Benefactor - our God and Saviour. -- I wrote a boyfriend of ours several months ago - Chris Adam - with whom we played and associated in our early boyhood, together with his little sisters, Lottie and Eattie; - poor youngsters! poorly instructed and left orphans at one of the most dangerous periods in life, just blooming into youth. I sent him badges of the Sacred Heart. He, too in his 8Os wrote back appreci- atively, in a way but seemed content with hardly any reference other than to material existence. "Lottie never married ... Hattie did ... and has three grown-up children ... " He wrote also of his own family and grand- children. Sorry I can't put my hand on his letter now.
